fact_text: On a daily chart the volume indicator shows one bar per trading day, and each bar's height is the number of shares traded that day.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '17. Unlock the Secret to Profitable Trading! How Volume Indicators Can Predict Market Moves in PSX' (YouTube, 2024-11-12)

fact_text: The analyst reads volume together with the candle's price move: the volume bar shows how many shares changed hands, and the price change shows whether buyers or sellers controlled that session.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '17. Unlock the Secret to Profitable Trading! How Volume Indicators Can Predict Market Moves in PSX' (YouTube, 2024-11-12)

fact_text: A price jump on lower volume than the previous session is read as aggressive buying, where buyers accept higher prices to get the shares they want.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '17. Unlock the Secret to Profitable Trading! How Volume Indicators Can Predict Market Moves in PSX' (YouTube, 2024-11-12)

fact_text: When volume falls session after session while price moves sideways in consolidation, the analyst reads fading interest in the stock, which can point to a later downside move because volume no longer supports price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '17. Unlock the Secret to Profitable Trading! How Volume Indicators Can Predict Market Moves in PSX' (YouTube, 2024-11-12)

fact_text: The analyst uses volume to judge whether a price trend is strong or weak and what price movement may follow.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '17. Unlock the Secret to Profitable Trading! How Volume Indicators Can Predict Market Moves in PSX' (YouTube, 2024-11-12)
